shared_elements: circular disc in low relief (with central boss/dot)
horizontal band(s) crossing the whole surface
angular hook/L- or arm-like element in relief
schematic low-relief motifs without interior detail
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, highly schematic relief consisting of a raised disc with a central boss set above a horizontal band that spans the full width, plus an angular hook- or arm-like element to one side, which is a moderately specific combination. However, A is a dense multi-register composition dominated by repeated zigzag/chevron rows, arcs and snake- or head-like figures, whereas B shows only a few isolated, widely spaced motifs on a plain field with no zigzag ornament or figural creatures at all.
